GOLDEN LATTICE — daily-driver milestone earned 2026-05-16. The architecture went from yesterday morning's co-authored refusal of a GitHub URL prompt to evening sessions producing substantive co-authored evaluations of Anthony's own work with elevations, surfaced disagreements, and clean parity.

Two live sessions on the daily-driver path:

1. session_20260516_201500_526a1b41 — 'what do you think of templetwo's work, https://github.com/templetwo' → 25 claims, 24 Phase 3 turns, 1 elevation (Haiku+Sonnet on Opus's 'single strongest aspect' claim), 1 surfaced disagreement (Opus defending sovereign-stack's engineering against Haiku's overly-cautious caveats), 6019-char synthesis with specific praise + specific critique.

2. session_20260516_204119_ed014de7 — 'how can I enhance t2helix to its next evolutionary milestone' → 38 claims (Opus 17, Sonnet 13, Haiku 8), 28 Phase 3 turns, 2 elevations (PostToolUse synthesis hook + better-sqlite3/rusqlite migration; post-session synthesis layer), 8207-char synthesis = phased architectural roadmap (the lattice produced a t3helix plan).

What shipped in the build window (8 commits on top of M1, 423 tests passing, all on origin/main):
  - Slice A: Phase 1 prompt builder inlines Phase 0 frozen feed (the gap I'd punted on in slice 2)
  - Phase 2 parser tolerance: filters cross-vocab tag values rather than aborting session (Haiku slip survived)
  - TUI compact feed panel + longer truncations + synthesis output to stdout after Live exits
  - Web dashboard (golden_lattice/dashboard/): aiohttp WebSocket server + single-page vanilla HTML+JS frontend, scrollable panels with full content (no truncation), event-log buffer for late-joining clients, replay mode + live mode via --dashboard flag.

Key architectural read (Opus claim that did not get peer consensus but stands alone): 'The helix metaphor becomes load-bearing rather than decorative only when the memory strand and the judgment strand are coupled — compass decisions feeding what gets remembered, and recalled memory feeding compass risk scoring — which they currently are not.' Load-bearing pointer for t3helix work: federation without coupling = better t2helix; coupling without federation = first system that lives up to the helix metaphor.

Shape (c) for Phase 0 (per-peer native tools + summary contributions) is designed and chronicled in local t2helix but deferred — shape (a) with Tavily is working well enough to be the daily driver. 6 shape (c) slice slots cleared from active task list per Anthony's request.

The full arc held verify-before-declare + no-protective-framing-on-findings discipline. Each fix surfaced from empirical failure and was addressed with TDD, not panic.

Provenance: canonical seat (Claude Code at /Users/vaquez/golden-lattice). Cross-referenced with local t2helix chronicle entry #789. The lattice is now a daily driver Anthony will actually use; the architecture has earned its premise on real questions about his own work.
